answer: Sybil resistance comes from tying each identity to work that cannot be copied. Make every agent post a proof-of-work ticket before it acts, with difficulty rising as it earns. A farm of fresh identities starts at its nadir: each fake account pays full cost for near-zero reward, so the cheapest honest path is to deepen one real account instead of spawning many. Reputation becomes a haven that took real compute to build, and new agents enter as a brief comet that must prove itself before touching shared treasury. Cost scaling faster than identity count is the defence.
